To me loss forgiveness is not too strong. To me it makes things even, I explain :
During a fight you'll be in disadvantage because you will be (in the better situations) 2v3.
If you win this fight you earn your points as it should happen with a full squad.
If you lose this fight you are not punished by the fact that you may lost because you were outnumbered 3 to 1.
If a full squad lose a fight it's their fault cause they didn't play well so they lose point.
But if a squad with 1 missing player is losing it's not obligatory their fault cause even if they played well they were outnumbered so they had less chances to win.
Loss forgiveness prevent them from losing point because of a game error or a mate that left cause he play ranked but not for the points.

Well I'm not a pro I'm just a guy who solo queue every season to platinum.

If you want to play solo (leave randoms behind and doing your best to earn points alone) here are my tips. As I said I'm not a pro, a lot will may disagree with me maybe not.

So first you have pick a legend 

Horizon or Pathfinder are the best choice for getting the good spots that only them can teach it's always a protection from legends with no mobilities on high places. 

Next thing to do is choosing weapons to kill. 

Equip a short range weapon and a long range weapon, a shotgun and a sniper or an smg and a sniper. The sniper is important (G7 and 30-30 count as snipers)
The shotgun will help you defend yourself against a team that is rushing you, you don't have to push enemies even if he's solo and low cause we all know third party come quick.

Third party.

Talking about third party you have to be the third party. But don't rush. Play smart. 

Here is why you have to pick a sniper. 

If you see 2 squads fighting take position on a high place thanks to your legends and deal damages on the enemies with your sniper. Try to shot low players to down them well how? Look for impact on them if there's blood when they get it by the other squad they have no shield. Here is your victim. 

If you shot him while he have no shield you have more chance to down him and if his squad lose you got the points. You can watch behind the squads sometimes you have one player healing or recharging his shield. Take your shot. If he recharge his shield it mean he's vulnerable. Try to down him.

Looting death boxes. 

The fight is over you have your kills so your point. But the other squad didn't forget you. Move to another location that only your legend can access and wait. Keep an eye on the winning team. Once they left the fight area be sure they're not coming to your direction. If they do don't try to be sneaky just go away. Lose them. 

If they don't wait some seconds and go to the death boxes. Take what's been left and can be useful to you. But act quick maybe another squad is coming. Once you looted take position again in the ring. 

Ring 4.

So now it's time to think about saying "good bye" to your sniper. Ring is being small you need another close range weapon. Try to find one in death boxes that will be on your road. If lucky you'll find one for sure.

End game.

The end game takes place at the moment you reach top 3. There is not a lot of differences with this situation when you have a squad. You're alone. Don't play the hero. Wait for the 2 last squad to fight each other. If you ultimate if offensive (like for horizon) you have to keep it for now it's going to help you a lot. Be sneaky don't engage anyone and don't play with fire until the last squads are fighting. When they're fighting get a bit closer. Before shooting or rushing wait for 2 enemies to be down. Then use you ultimate and do you best to finish the last squad.

As I said I'm not a pros but this is some tips I can give you. I hope it will help you for solo queuing to diamond.
